html:
G'oya

Jamoa o'yinda ikki rolda bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun har bir o'yinni ikki qatorga ajratamiz: biri uy egasi uchun, biri mehmon uchun. Har bir qatorda jamoa va u olgan ochko bor. UNION ALL ikki ro'yxatni ustma-ust qo'yadi, keyin oddiy guruhlash qoladi. O'ynamagan jamoalar yo'qolmasligi uchun teams dan LEFT JOIN qilamiz.

Yechim

SELECT t.name AS team, COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) AS points
FROM teams t
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT home_id AS team_id,
         CASE WHEN home_goals > away_goals THEN 3
              WHEN home_goals = away_goals THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END AS points
  FROM matches
  UNION ALL
  SELECT away_id,
         CASE WHEN away_goals > home_goals THEN 3
              WHEN away_goals = home_goals THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END
  FROM matches
) p ON p.team_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.name

Ikkinchi CASE birinchisining ko'zgudagi aksi: gollar o'rni almashgan. Namunada Paxtakor uch o'yinda 3, 1 va 3 ochko olgan, jami 7. Ikkinchi g'alabasi mehmonlikda: Navbahor 1:2 Paxtakor.

Tuzoqlar

UNION takroriy qatorlarni o'chiradi. Paxtakorning ikki g'alabasi bir xil qator beradi, (1, 3), ulardan biri yo'qoladi va jami 7 emas, 4 chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT t.name AS team, COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) AS points
FROM teams t
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT home_id AS team_id,
         CASE WHEN home_goals > away_goals THEN 3
              WHEN home_goals = away_goals THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END AS points
  FROM matches
  UNION
  SELECT away_id,
         CASE WHEN away_goals > home_goals THEN 3
              WHEN away_goals = home_goals THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END
  FROM matches
) p ON p.team_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.name

Faqat home_id bo'yicha ulash mehmonlikdagi ochkolarni yo'qotadi. Oddiy JOIN esa o'ynamagan jamoani natijadan chiqarib yuboradi. LEFT JOIN bilan uning SUM i NULL bo'ladi, COALESCE uni 0 qiladi.

Boshqa yo'l

Jamoaga uning hamma o'yinlarini OR bilan ulab, ochkoni bitta CASE da hisoblash ham mumkin. Bu holda CASE jamoa qaysi tomonda o'ynaganini o'zi tekshirishi kerak:

SELECT t.name AS team,
       SUM(CASE
             WHEN m.home_id = t.id AND m.home_goals > m.away_goals THEN 3
             WHEN m.away_id = t.id AND m.away_goals > m.home_goals THEN 3
             WHEN m.home_goals = m.away_goals THEN 1
             ELSE 0
           END) AS points
FROM teams t
LEFT JOIN matches m ON m.home_id = t.id OR m.away_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.name

O'ynamagan jamoada m ustunlari NULL, birorta WHEN ham rost bo'lmaydi va ELSE 0 ishlaydi, shuning uchun COALESCE kerak emas.
